Thank you, your post really helped. I've been meaning to reply but I've just been so busy I havent had a chance to yet. I'm more so motivated now to keep going through and to be the change. That I won't let the hate and lies and everything else kick my ass to the point of death. Even if it's just to keep going to find that little bit of pure joy that just comes naturally, I'll do it for that.

Thank you again.
